function.name: Services_1_BookAppointment
function.description: Books an appointment with a specified hair stylist or salon on a given date and time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

appointment_date.description: The desired date for the appointment, in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

appointment_time.description: The desired time for the appointment, in 24-hour format 'HH:MM'.

function.name: Services_1_FindProvider

city.description: The city where the salon is located, such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'New York, NY'.

is_unisex.description: Indicates if the salon accommodates all genders. 'True' for yes, 'False' for no, 'dontcare' for no preference.
